title: BlackboardEntry
description: One typed row on the blackboard, written by exactly one bounded worker during one iteration. The base envelope shared by every entry kind (signal | observation | gap | calculation | analysis | synthesis | source). source_refs[] carries the PROVENANCE handles the entry leans on (BlackboardSourceRef ids) so no claim is sourceless. serves_truth is pinned const false — a blackboard entry is analytical working state, NEVER served truth; Baltor decides separately (see GovernedBlackboardEntry) whether anything derived from it may be promoted. author_worker_id + iteration give per-row lineage for receipts and convergence accounting.

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this entry belongs to

kind.description: the typed entry kind; determines which specialized contract (BlackboardSignal/Observation/Gap/Calculation/Analysis/Synthesis/SourceRef) carries its body

author_worker_id.description: id of the bounded worker that wrote this entry (lineage)

iteration.description: iteration/round in which this entry was written

source_refs.description: BlackboardSourceRef ids this entry leans on (provenance handles); may be empty for purely procedural kinds (signal) but an observation must be non-empty per BlackboardObservation

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — a blackboard entry is analytical working state, never served truth; promotion is a separate Baltor-governed decision

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the entry was written
